title: Projection Integrity Assessment v1
description: Content-light integrity assessment for a desktop projection. Contains no raw receipt payloads, logs, or output — only status enums, violation codes, counts, and timestamps.

integrity_status.description: Overall integrity status of this projection's receipt backing.

contract_status.description: Contract satisfaction status based on violation severity.

violation_count.description: Total number of integrity violations detected.

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the assessment was performed.

stale_receipt_count.description: Number of receipt records exceeding the stale threshold.

orphaned_receipt_count.description: Number of receipt records missing required linkage fields.

authority_backed.description: Whether all claimed authorities have corresponding receipt backing.

ProjectionViolationCode.description: Canonical violation codes for projection integrity checks.
